key_insight: Generative Trajectory Planning treats a diffusion model as a proposal distribution for action sequences, then refines sampled trajectories with learned dynamics, reward, and value models to enable efficient long-horizon planning.
engineering_relevance: This gives practitioners a practical way to combine generative modeling with model-based control, improving trajectory-level decision making without solving a full optimization problem from scratch at every step.
method: Learn a diffusion prior over action sequences as a generative sampler.
Refine sampled trajectories using learned dynamics, reward, and value estimates.
Use the resulting candidate plans for online decision making in continuous control and manipulation.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that GTP matches or exceeds strong model-free, diffusion-policy, and model-based baselines on continuous control and long-horizon manipulation tasks, with better stability in regimes where those baselines degrade.
watch_item: Performance likely depends on the quality of the learned dynamics, reward, and value models, so model error or distribution shift could reduce plan quality.
paper_title: Model-Based Online Decision Making via Generative Trajectory Planning
